explanation: Answers erdosproblems.com/202's 'how large can r be?' with the reported resolution f(N) = N·L(N)^{-1+o(1)}, where L(N) = exp(√(log N log log N)) (GPT-5.4 Pro via [BFV13] plus Park–Pham; formal proof linked). f(N) is the maximum number of distinct moduli ≤ N carrying pairwise disjoint residue classes. Writing it as an exact equality with some o(1) exponent is equivalent to the asymptotic statement, given f(N) > 0 for large N.
